failing_case: deps.toml lists node (brew node / apt nodejs), install.sh installs it, relay doctor checks it, and bin/ci:30 refuses to start without node on PATH.
pass_cases: install.sh --dry on macOS and on Linux has no node step
bin/ci --quick starts with no node on PATH
every hook test or script that ran node runs under bun, and the guard tests that only match the text "node -e" in a command stay
findings.summary: Node is installed and required, though the owner wants bun and no Node

notes: Owner, verbatim: "Не хочу пользоваться node, лучше bun, запускай по их инструкции".
scope: The owner's answers on the installer, 24 Oct: no Node, use bun; run the claude and bun official installers as their instructions say.
